---
title: Combining results from Prioritizations
---

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scico)
```

## Read in data

Base hexes (currie paper)
```{r}
# Some hexes are duplicatde, so we slice head for each scenario below
hexes <- read_sf("analyses/currie/Hexbins_100km_EA_ED.shp") |> 
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
# ggplot(hexes[duplicated(hexes$OBJECTID_1),]) + geom_sf()
# st_write(hexes[duplicated(hexes$OBJECTID_1),], "analyses/currie/results/hexes_dup.shp")
```

Currie results
```{r}
# All scenarios
# Choice: only taking solution 1
currie_20 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target20_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_20") |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
currie_30 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target30_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_30") |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
currie_40 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target40_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_40") |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
currie_50 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target50_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_50")  |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)

currie_all <- bind_rows(currie_20, currie_30, currie_40, currie_50) |>
    # mutate(sol_sum = solution_1 + solution_2 + solution_3 + solution_4 + solution_5) |>
    select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID, solution_5, target, geometry)

# Only 1s
currie_all_filt <- currie_all |> 
    # mutate(sol_sum_bin = sol_sum > 0) |>
    # filter(sol_sum_bin != 0) |>
    # select(-sol_sum)
    filter(solution_5 == 1)

# Summarize all scenarios
currie_all_filt_sum <- currie_all_filt |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = target, 
                values_from = solution_5, values_fill = 0) |>
    mutate(priority = t_20 + t_30 + t_40 + t_50) |>
    select(-starts_with("t_"))

ggplot(currie_all_filt_sum) + geom_sf(aes(fill = priority), color = NA) + 
    scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik")

currie_list <- list(currie_20 = currie_20, 
                    currie_30 = currie_30, 
                    currie_40 = currie_40, 
                    currie_50 = currie_50)

# Write out figures
for (sce_name in names(currie_list)) {
    sce <- currie_list[[sce_name]]
    for (sol in 1:5) {
        plot_name <- paste0(sce_name, "_sol_", sol)
        sol_var <- paste0("solution_", sol)
        p <- ggplot(sce |> filter(.data[[sol_var]] > 0)) + 
            geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[sol_var]]), color = NA) +
            ggtitle(plot_name) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        ggsave(paste0("analyses/currie/results/", plot_name, ".png"), p)
    }
}

# Let's assume that what we want is currie 30, solution #1
currie_final <- currie_30 |> filter(solution_1 > 0)
st_write(currie_final, "results/currie_final.shp", delete_dsn = T)
```

For Eckert

```{r}
hexes_eckert <- hexes |> select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID)
main_rast <- rast("analyses/eckert/21732722/Rank Maps/Binary Run Maps/MASTER.tif") |> 
    project (currie_final)
main_rast[main_rast != 0] <- 1
main_rast[main_rast == 0] <- 0
main_rast[is.na(main_rast)] <- 0
plot(main_rast)
# terra::writeRaster(main_rast, "results/eckert_master_bin.tiff")

# turn to same 100km grid for comparison
extracted <- terra::extract(main_rast, hexes, fun = modal)
eckert_final <- hexes |> bind_cols(extracted) |>
    filter(MASTER == 1)

ggplot(eckert_final) + 
    geom_sf(aes(fill = MASTER), color = NA) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

st_write(eckert_final, "results/eckert_final.shp", delete_dsn = T)
```
